description.narrative: The Partner Identification will take place in Lebanon, where the two potential partner organizations are located. The chosen partner organizations, ‘The Mena Trauma Healing Center’ and ‘The Marara Youth Center’, match the values, visions, and policies of DUF as they wish to raise awareness on the importance of mental health work and do this by promoting basic human rights for children and youth, gender equality, democratic citizen participation, and better life opportunities and equality between different population groups. The partner organizations also match IU with their values and in the way they engage the local community in the projects through peer-to-peer collaboration as well as focusing on empowering the future generation by developing educational practices through NGO work. Our hope for this project is to establish a partnership project that fits into the existing local cultural framework, but with the possibility of incorporating experiences such as learning communities, democratic values, and gender equalities within the project.
